paragraphs: Not enough disabled people in Ireland have jobs. Minister Dara Calleary said this on Saturday. He is the minister for social protection.
The State has a plan to help. It pays part of the wages of disabled workers. Before, a worker had to work at least 15 hours a week. Now the number is eight hours.
Employers get between €7.50 and €10 an hour for each worker. In October, 2,695 people were in the plan. The plan cost €22.1 million in 2025.
Calleary said the shop Mr Price is a good example. About 18% of its staff have a disability.
Maurice Quinlivan is a TD. He said the job gap in Ireland is one of the biggest in Europe. He wants more money for the plan. Calleary will meet employers in January.
sentZh: 在愛爾蘭，有工作的身心障礙者不夠多。
部長達拉・凱勒里週六這樣表示。
他是社會保障部長。
國家有一項幫助計畫。
它支付身心障礙員工部分薪水。
以前，員工每週至少要工作15小時。
現在這個數字是8小時。
雇主每名員工每小時可獲7.50至10歐元。
十月時，有2,695人參加這項計畫。
這項計畫在2025年花費2,210萬歐元。
凱勒里說，Mr Price商店是很好的例子。
該店約18%的員工有身心障礙。
莫里斯・昆利文是一名國會議員。
他說愛爾蘭的就業差距是歐洲最大之一。
他希望為這項計畫投入更多錢。
凱勒里將在一月與雇主會面。

paragraphs: Too few people with disabilities have jobs in Ireland, according to the Minister for Social Protection, Dara Calleary. He wants to change that by making it easier for employers to hire them.

Under the State wage subsidy scheme, the Government pays part of the wages of a disabled worker. Until now, the job had to be at least 15 hours a week. In Budget 2027, Calleary cut this to eight hours. A review in 2024 had suggested cutting it from 21 hours to 15. The scheme is also open now to community and voluntary groups.

In October, 1,614 employers and 2,695 workers used the scheme. It cost €22.1 million in 2025. Employers get €7.50 an hour per worker if they have one to six disabled staff, and up to €10 an hour if they have 25 or more.
Calleary praised the shop chain Mr Price, where about 18% of staff have a disability. He said he will talk to employer groups during January.

Maurice Quinlivan, who chairs the Oireachtas disability committee, welcomed the change. However, he said the gap between disabled and other workers in Ireland is among the highest in Europe. He wants a bigger subsidy and more career support for young disabled people.
sentZh: 社會保障部長達拉・凱勒里表示，愛爾蘭有工作的身心障礙者太少。
他希望讓雇主更容易僱用他們，來改變這種情況。
根據國家工資補貼計畫，政府支付身心障礙員工的部分工資。
到目前為止，這份工作每週至少要有15小時。
在2027年預算中，凱勒里把這個門檻降到8小時。
2024年的一份審查報告曾建議從21小時降到15小時。

Following consultation with stakeholders, Budget 2027 reduced the minimum weekly hours required from 15 to eight. Notably, a 2024 review had recommended a considerably more modest reduction, from 21 to 15 hours. Furthermore, eligibility has been extended to voluntary, community and non-commercial semi-State bodies.

As of October, 1,614 employers and 2,695 employees were participating, and expenditure in 2025 totalled €22.1 million. The hourly subsidy is contingent upon the size of the disabled workforce, ranging from €7.50 to €10, while the annual grant for an employment assistance officer has increased from €30,000 to €45,000.

The Minister cited the retailer Mr Price, where approximately 18% of employees have a disability, as a model of inclusive practice, and he intends to engage with employer organisations throughout January.
